author: nflaig
content:
one of the concerns I raised is
> [IGNORE] this bid is the highest value bid seen for the tuple (bid.slot, bid.parent_block_hash, bid.parent_block_root)
since boost factor for example would only apply to your local bids you already have in the pool, but even if you boost a specific builders bid a lot it might not even be propagated to you, and same goes the other way around, even if you do a 0 boost on a specific builder to "blacklist" them, then they might still have submitted the highest bid for `(bid.slot, bid.parent_block_hash, bid.parent_block_root)`, meaning other bids that are lower didn't propagate in some cases
